# Family and friends

## What you will learn
Use mother, father, sister, brother and friend to talk about people. My and your show whose relative or friend you mean.

## Example in context
This is my sister. Her name is Anna. She is my friend too.

## How to use it
Read the example aloud. Identify the rule, then make a new sentence with your own words. Check word order and spelling.

## Common mistake
He refers to a boy or man; she to a girl or woman.

## Practice and reflection
Write: «Это мой брат».
**Model answer:** This is my brother.

Try changing one word in the example without breaking the rule.
levels.easy:
